title: QU, GU and C

summary_es.en: Silent “u” in que, qui, gue, gui, and “c” before e and i.
summary_es.fr: « u » muet dans que, qui, gue, gui, et « c » devant e et i.
summary_es.zh: que, qui, gue, gui 中的 u 不发音，e、i 前的 c 的读法。
summary_es.ja: que, qui, gue, gui の u は発音せず、e・i の前の c の読み方。

tip_es: “qu” always sounds /k/ and the “u” is silent: queso, quiero. “gu” before “e” or “i” sounds /g/ and the “u” is silent: guerra, guitarra. “c” before “e” or “i” sounds /θ/ (like English “th” in “think”) in most of Spain, and /s/ in Latin America.
